name: UGC Automation Livepeer Direct Video Output v16.4

nodes.name: Parse Message
nodes.notes: Parses /generate messages, validates an attached product photo, manages the 30-minute session lock, and supports resuming a saved Livepeer job.

nodes.name: Get Telegram File Info
nodes.notes: Downloads the Telegram photo into n8n binary data so Livepeer can ingest it without needing a Telegram bot-token URL.

nodes.name: Prepare Livepeer Image Upload
nodes.notes: Converts the downloaded Telegram image to base64 for the Livepeer MCP upload tool. No Telegram bot token is embedded in the image URL.

nodes.name: Livepeer Agent — Upload Image
nodes.notes: Uploads the Telegram image to Livepeer MCP and returns an accessible handoff URL for image-to-video generation.

nodes.name: Extract Livepeer Upload URL
nodes.notes: Extracts the public HTTPS URL returned by the Livepeer upload tool and carries the original Telegram/session fields forward.

nodes.name: Store Session
nodes.notes: Stores the session using the Livepeer-hosted image URL, avoiding Telegram file URLs.

parameters.text:

values.content:
=You are a professional UGC ad script writer.

Product Name:
{{ $('Parse Message').item.json.productName }}

Description:
{{ $('Parse Message').item.json.productDescription }}

Write a concise 15-second product-focused UGC script that can also be used as visual direction for an image-to-video generator.

Requirements:
- Strong hook in first 3 seconds
- Natural human speech
- Conversational tone
- Product focused
- Clear visual actions that can be represented from the supplied product image
- End with a call to action

Return only the script.

nodes.name: Extract Script
nodes.notes: Extracts the script and uses the Livepeer-uploaded image URL.

parameters.text: ={{$json.message || $json.error?.message || 'Something went wrong. Try: /generate Product | Description with a photo attached.'}}

nodes.name: Livepeer Agent — Run Capability
nodes.notes: Runs the selected Livepeer capability on the raw MCP surface. In the validated ltx-25-i2v-fast execution, the tool returned a completed video URL directly, so no mjob_/job polling is used.

nodes.name: Download Livepeer MP4
nodes.notes: Downloads the generated Livepeer MP4 into binary property data for Telegram.

parameters.content:
PUBLIC GITHUB SETUP NOTES

This workflow requires credentials to be configured in your own n8n instance.

Required services:
1. Telegram Bot API credential
2. Anthropic API credential for the script-generation step
3. Livepeer Agent MCP authentication for the Livepeer MCP nodes

Configure your own credentials after importing this workflow. No API keys or bot tokens are hardcoded in this public workflow.

The workflow uploads the Telegram image through Livepeer MCP, generates the video with the selected Livepeer capability, downloads the resulting MP4, and sends it back to Telegram.

nodes.name: Extract Livepeer Video URL
nodes.notes: Extracts the final MP4 URL from structuredContent.url returned directly by run_capability. No job polling.
